items.titleEn: Prospects who could be dealt by the Trade Deadline -- one for each team
bodyEn: The Trade Deadline is approaching: Monday at 6 p.m. ET. Deals will be made and prospects will change addresses.

Since the pandemic, an average of four Top 100 Prospects have been traded each July. Last year, the Padres gave up No. 3 overall ranked Leo De Vries in a package sent to the Athletics for Mason Miller, while the Phillies surrendered Eduardo Tait (No. 56) and Mick Abel (No. 92) to pry Jhoan Duran from the Twins. A total of 63 players ranked on MLB Pipeline's organization Top 30s were used as trade fodder.

Who might be on the move this year? We identify one potential prospect from every organization who could get dealt below. Obviously, non-contenders such as the Angels and Rockies are more likely to acquire youngsters than part with them, but that won't stop us from speculating.
Jump to: AL East | AL Central | AL West | NL East | NL Central | NL West
AMERICAN LEAGUE EAST

Blue Jays: Nolan Perry, RHP (No. 3/MLB No. 93)Toronto is widely expected to sell at this Deadline, but there have still been rumors that they could still seek out controllable starting pitching with an eye on 2027 and beyond. The organization’s improved pitching pipeline helped turn Kendry Rojas and Khal Stephen into desirable pieces at last year’s Deadline, and Perry (who is currently on the injured list for a concussion) has followed in their breakout steps in his climb from Single-A to Double-A. Again, expect Toronto to add more prospects than it subtracts, but this time of year represents an opportunity to improve in many facets.

Orioles: Enrique Bradfield Jr. (No. 10)The O’s are likely not in big-time buying mode, though they remain in the hunt for a Wild Card spot. But even if they’re in sell mode, a player like Bradfield could be of interest to a team competing. He might be more of a fourth outfielder, but his speed and defense – he’s stolen 25 bases and hit .298 over his last 30 games – could be useful for a team making a playoff push.

Rays: Michael Forret, RHP (No. 8)Tampa Bay is in an enviable spot with the first seed in the American League postseason picture and a deep farm system from which to deal. With many selling teams seeking near-MLB-ready pitching help in their returns – hello, Detroit – Forret could present an intriguing option. Acquired from the Orioles last offseason in the Shane Baz deal, Forret is up at Triple-A, where he’s struck out 26.7 percent of his batters faced over eight starts with a deep arsenal. (He’s been better than his 5.23 ERA alone would indicate.) Forret is also Rule 5-eligible this offseason, and moving him would help the Rays clear out what could be a major 40-man logjam.

Red Sox: Kyson Witherspoon, RHP (No. 4)Witherspoon's pro debut hasn't gone as smoothly as hoped, but he still was the No. 15 overall pick out of Oklahoma a year ago and has intriguing arm talent. His fastball averages 95 mph and reaches 98, though it lacks life, and he's getting outs with a mid-80s slider and splitter. He has posted a 5.01 ERA with 73 strikeouts in 70 innings in High-A

Yankees: Elmer Rodríguez, RHP (No. 3/MLB No. 73)Rodríguez already has been traded once, going from the Red Sox to the Yankees in a 2024 Winter Meetings trade for Carlos Narvaez. His mid-90s sinker is a groundball-producing machine and he can miss bats with an upper-70s curveball and an upper-80s splitter. He has logged a 2.93 ERA, .223 opponent average and 77 strikeouts in 76 2/3 Triple-A innings while also compiling a 4.76 ERA in four big league starts.
AMERICAN LEAGUE CENTRAL

Guardians: Cooper Ingle, C/OF (No. 3/MLB No. 59)A 2023 fifth-round pick from Clemson, Ingle is an athletic catcher who also can play the outfield corners and leads the Triple-A International League with a .987 OPS. He's slashing .307/.424/.563 with a career-high 14 homers in 64 Triple-A contests and went 2-for-21 with 12 strikeouts in his first taste of the big leagues in late June and early July.

Royals: Gavin Cross, OF (No. 25)With the Royals in sell mode, they’ll try to bulk up the farm, not lose anything from it, but Cross makes for an intriguing arrow-up option for any team in need of left-handed-hitting outfield help. The 2022 ninth overall pick has homered in six straight games for Triple-A Omaha, thanks in part to an adjustment to add a toe tap into his load. Since the start of June, Cross is hitting .316/.368/.589 with 10 homers and a 139 wRC+ over 42 games. Primarily a right fielder (with some time in left), Cross is blocked by Jac Caglianone in K.C. anyways, even if it seems more likely that his current club would want to give him his first MLB look.

Tigers: Eduardo Valencia, C/1B (No. 11)Valencia hasn’t slowed down much since last year’s breakout season in the upper Minors first put him on the 40-man, and he’s been incredible in a short MLB sample, highlighted by Tuesday’s two-homer performance. He’s also a backstop in the same organization as cornerstone and fellow righty slugger Dillon Dingler, who is only one year older than him. The Tigers are another team trending in a selling direction, but think of how many teams are seeking catching help this Deadline.

Twins: Marek Houston, SS (No. 5)With the Twins just two games out in the AL Central and only a half-game out (as of this writing) of a Wild Card spot, GM Jeremy Zoll said recently they’d be buyers. Top 100 guys like Walker Jenkins and Kaelen Culpepper, both knocking on the door at Triple-A, seem less likely, but with Culpepper just about ready, that could make another shortstop like Houston, available. The club’s first-rounder in 2025 has had a terrific first full season, reaching Double-A and hitting a combined .327/.408/.480 with a 130 wRC+ and his plus defense up the middle.

White Sox: Billy Carlson, SS (No. 3/MLB No. 57)Several scouts identified Carlson as the best defensive prep shortstop they've ever evaluated, which is why the White Sox drafted him 10th overall in 2025. But the surprising AL Central leaders are also overflowing with talent at that position, including big league starter Colson Montgomery and 2026 No. 1 overall pick Roch Cholowsky. Carlson has batted .267/.396/.361 with 12 steals in 47 games in Single-A and recently returned after missing seven weeks with a fractured left thumb.
AMERICAN LEAGUE WEST

Angels: George Klassen, RHP (No. 9)The Angels are tied for having the worst record in baseball, so adding big leaguers seems improbable, but Klassen could add some return value to combine with big league talent they might try to send out of Los Angeles. They got Klassen at the Deadline in 2024, and he has big league time this season, and the 24-year old still has premium stuff, with a fastball that touches triple digits and a slider that misses a lot of bats. Maybe a contending team could shorten him up and use him as bullpen depth down the stretch.

Astros: Anthony Huezo, OF (No. 15)Huezo took a while to get going after the Astros drafted him in the 12th round from a California high school in 2023, but he led the Australian Baseball League with a 1.031 OPS last offseason and is just one of four Minor Leaguers who have amassed at least 15 homers and 30 steals this season. Possessing plus raw power and solid speed, he's hitting .248/.347/.513 with 17 homers and 32 steals in 79 games at two Class A levels, though his strikeout rate (30 percent) remains a cause for concern.

A’s: Zane Taylor, RHP (No. 18)The A’s were only three games out of the AL West lead at the start of July but have stumbled this month and now sit 10 games out, so the chances of them buying are slim. The top of their Top 30 is improving, especially with the impending addition of their 2026 Draft class, and is likely to stay intact. Taylor is a member of last year’s Draft haul, taken in the fifth round, who is having a solid first full season, pitching his way recently to Double-A after posting a 3.22 ERA over 16 starts with High-A Lansing.

Mariners: Michael Arroyo, 2B/OF (No. 5/MLB No. 40)While there’s been a lot of buzz about the Mariners potentially trading from their big league rotation to improve the Major League roster, they certainly have the pieces down on the farm to sweeten, or lead, a deal. They’re not afraid to trade Top 100 guys, as they did with Harry Ford last offseason, but you have to think the top two arms, Kade Anderson and Ryan Sloan, aren’t going anywhere. But there are four other Top 100 guys who could be offered up. Arroyo can really hit (.842 combined OPS) and he’s only 21 while raking in Triple-A. There’s no clear path for playing time in Seattle for him, nor does he have an obvious long-term defensive home, so a change of scenery could be good for him as well.

Rangers: Dylan Dreiling, OF (No. 10)The Most Outstanding Player at the 2024 College World Series, where he homered in all three games in the finals to lead Tennessee to the national title, Dreiling went in the second round a month later. He's appealing as a left-handed hitter with a sound approach, bat-to-ball skills and plus raw power, and he has been one of the best hitters in the Double-A Texas League, slashing .290/.367/.486 with 15 homers and 10 steals in 83 games.
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter
NATIONAL LEAGUE EAST

Braves: Alex Lodise, SS (No. 5)The Braves are back atop the NL East, preparing for a postseason run and, frankly, pretty much anyone in their system should be open for conversation, even if they eventually hold on to their top guys. The 2025 Draft has provided Top 10 guys like Tate Southisene and Briggs McKenzie, along with Lodise, their second-round pick. While he hasn’t taken the leap forward this year that Southisene has, the infielder’s power has shown up, with 21 homers to go along with 15 steals, earning a recent promotion to High-A Rome.

Marlins: Kemp Alderman, OF/1B (No. 7)While Alderman stands out most with his massive raw power and high-end exit velocities, he's also deceptively athletic for a 6-foot-3, 225-pounder and possesses plus arm strength. He's batting .290/.367/.496 with 15 homers in 67 Triple-A games and is back to full health after missing a month with a sprained left elbow.

Mets: Jonathan Pintaro, RHP (No. 15)Pintaro has ridden the Syracuse shuttle plenty this season, and entering Wednesday, he has five MLB appearances to his name, during which he’s struck out 12 and limited opponents to a .143 average-against. An independent league find in 2024, Pintaro deserves credit for pushing to the Major Leagues, but he’s also older than many prospects at 28. He could be included in a larger package to help build bullpen depth for a contender who values his cutter-first arsenal.

Nationals: Coy James, SS (No. 18)Washington seems willing to buy and sell at this year’s Deadline, as evidenced by the Curtis Mead-Connelly Early swap with Boston, as it stays within reach of an NL Wild Card spot. If the Nats do buy, they won’t likely dip into their upper echelon of prospects, but James, who was taken in the fifth round last year before the current front office took over, could be an intriguing name in that next group. The 19-year-old has shown some pop with 14 homers in 85 games with Single-A Fredericksburg while playing shortstop, second base, third base and even some left field.

Phillies: Bryan Rincon, SS (No. 15)The Phillies don’t shy away from dealing from their prospect ranks in their annual push for the playoffs.. Just look at last year’s Deadline, when they sent Eduardo Tait and Mick Abel to the Twins for Jhoan Duran. It might be more likely that current Top 100 prospect Gage Wood helps in Philly than he’s offered in a deal, so we’ll look a little further down the list with Rincon, who is enjoying a bit of a breakout season in Double-A. It’s not just Reading-aided – his new power is showing up on the road as well – and he’s an absolutely terrific defensive shortstop.
NATIONAL LEAGUE CENTRAL

Brewers: Josh Adamczewski, OF (No. 6/MLB No. 88)The Crew remains loaded on the farm at a time when the MLB club could enter the postseason as the No. 1 seed in the NL. Whether they push in their prospect chips will be one of the storylines of the Deadline, but if they do get aggressive, Adamczewski’s name could come up a lot in larger deals. The 21-year-old left-handed slugger has built on last year’s breakout to hit .313/.431/.546 with a career high 14 homers in 81 games between High-A and Double-A, while moving from second base to left field full-time. With a line-drive-heavy approach, Adamczewski would have one of the better hit tools in many other organizations.

Cardinals: Leo Bernal, C (No. 5)St. Louis certainly has a catching crunch with Pedro Pagés, Iván Herrera and Jimmy Crooks in the bigs, Bernal at Triple-A and top prospect Rainiel Rodriguez at Double-A. It’s a good problem to have for sure, and Bernal has contributed to that by hitting .275/.358/.471 with 13 homers over 79 games in his first taste of Memphis. With exceptional pop times to second base, his arm is also looking ready for The Show. Moving him before his debut could get a significant return, either in MLB talent or prospects to fortify other needier areas of the farm.

Cubs: Jefferson Rojas, 3B/SS (No. 2/MLB No. 64)The injury-ravaged Cubs desperately need pitching and while they probably won't trade their top prospect (outfielder Josiah Hartshorn), they might have to part with their second-best to get some mound help. Signed for $1 million out of the Dominican Republic in 2022, Rojas is hitting .269/.334/.462 with 15 homers in 86 Double-A games at age 21 and has the arm strength for the left side of the infield.

Pirates: Wyatt Sanford, SS (No. 4)Who the Pirates are willing to part with might depend on how big of a splash they want to make. If, say, Mason Miller, were available (seems like he’s not), perhaps an Edward Florentino or Murf Gray could be made available. Sanford was creeping into Top 100 territory by hitting his offensive stride, especially power-wise, in Greensboro this year before a hand injury shelved him. The Pirates have some up-the-middle infield depth in the organization, beginning with Konnor Griffin in Pittsburgh, so this would be dealing from an area of strength.

Reds: Tyson Lewis, SS/3B (No. 4)Last year at this time, the Reds sent young infielder Sammy Stafura to the Pirates for Ke’Bryan Hayes to help with a successful Wild Card push. They’re more likely to be sellers this year, but if they wanted to use some of their infield prospect depth again, they could try to use Lewis to help them flip the switch back to competing more quickly. There are some approach issues to work on, but there’s raw power and speed, with the hot corner his likely full-time home.
NATIONAL LEAGUE WEST

D-backs: Carlos Virahonda, C (No. 10)As with the Cardinals, the D-backs have picked up enviable depth behind the plate with Virahonda, Alberto Barriga (No. 14) and Ivan Luciano (No. 21) already in the pipeline and Arkansas backstop Ryder Helfrick joining the fun as a 2026 first-rounder. It’s that depth that Arizona could dip into here, and Virahonda might draw some intrigue as a potential above-average defender who has already hit 16 homers between Single-A and High-A this season, blowing away his previous career best of four set last year.

Dodgers: Zyhir Hope, OF (No. 5/MLB No. 25)How loaded are the Dodgers? They feature more Top 100 Prospects (nine) than anyone and while Hope ranks No. 25 on that list, he's only their fifth-best prospect and fourth-highest-ranked outfielder. Acquired from the Cubs as part of the Michael Busch trade in January 2024, he's a potential 25-25 guy with well above-average raw power, solid speed and the tools to play anywhere in the outfield. He's enjoying a strong season in Double-A at age 21, slashing .288/.367/.517 with 21 homers and 18 steals in 91 games and leading the Texas League with 84 RBIs.

Giants: Blade Tidwell, RHP (No. 11)Tidwell got traded at last year's deadline, arriving from the Mets in a package for Tyler Rogers, and his two best weapons are a mid-90s fastball that reaches 99 with carry and a low-80s sweeper. Tidwell has spent much of this season as a starter in Triple-A, where he has fashioned a 4.21 ERA with 75 strikeouts in 66 1/3 innings, and he has also compiled a 3.00 ERA in eight relief outings with San Francisco.

Padres: Kash Mayfield, LHP (No. 2)San Diego can never be ruled out of making the Trade Deadline interesting, and this recent four-game winning streak (entering Wednesday) should push them firmly back in the buying direction. While there will be plenty of asks around top prospect Ethan Salas, it might be more likely that San Diego dips into its growing pool of young arms to make moves. A first-round pick in 2024, Mayfield owns a 3.54 ERA with 62 strikeouts in 53 1/3 innings for High-A Fort Wayne this season, and while he’s still not a big velo guy (sitting 90-93 mph with his fastball), his 82-84 mph changeup continues to look like a potential plus pitch.

Rockies: Zac Veen, OF (No. 7)The Rockies are trying to rebuild, so their system will likely remain intact. But Veen could use a change of scenery. While it seems like we’ve been talking about him forever, he’s still only 24 and he’s having his best statistical year yet (.313/.389/.580) with 17 homers and 15 steals in Triple-A, yet hasn’t gotten another shot at showing what he can do in Colorado after making his big league debut last year.
items.titleZh: 交易截止日可能被交易的潜力新秀——每队一位
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟预计成为卖家，可能会交易右投手Nolan Perry。
bodyZh: 交易截止日临近：美国东部时间周一晚6点。交易将达成，潜力新秀将更换东家。
自疫情以来，每年7月平均有4名百大潜力新秀被交易。去年，教士队将排名第3的Leo De Vries作为交易筹码送至运动家队换来Mason Miller，而费城人队则送出Eduardo Tait（第56位）和Mick Abel（第92位）从双城队得到Jhoan Duran。共有63名入选MLB Pipeline球队前30的球员被用作交易筹码。
今年谁可能被交易？我们为每支球队确定一位可能被交易的潜力新秀。显然，非竞争球队如天使队和洛矶队更可能获得年轻球员而非送走他们，但这并不妨碍我们做出推测。

美国联盟东区

蓝鸟：Nolan Perry，右投手（第3位/MLB第93位）多伦多普遍预计将在截止日前成为卖家，但仍有传言称他们可能寻求可控的先发投手，着眼于2027年及以后。球队改善的投手新秀管道帮助Kendry Rojas和Khal Stephen在去年截止日成为有价值的筹码，而Perry（目前因脑震荡进入伤病名单）在从1A升到2A的过程中延续了类似的爆发之路。再次强调，预计多伦多会增加更多新秀而非减少，但每年这个时候是改善多个方面的机会。
金莺：Enrique Bradfield Jr.（第10位）金莺可能不会大举买入，但他们仍在争夺外卡席位。不过即使他们进入卖模式，像Bradfield这样的球员可能引起竞争球队的兴趣。他可能更多是第四外野手，但他的速度和防守——过去30场比赛盗垒25次，打击率.298——对冲击季后赛的球队可能有用。

光芒：Michael Forret，右投手（第8位）坦帕湾处于令人羡慕的位置，在美国联盟季后赛种子中排名第一，并且有深厚的农场系统可用于交易。由于许多卖家寻求接近大联盟水平的投手作为回报——你好，底特律——Forret可能是一个有趣的选择。Forret在去年休赛期从Shane Baz交易中被金莺换来，目前已在3A，先发8场，三振率为26.7%，武器库丰富。（他的表现比5.23自责分率所显示的更好。）Forret在本休赛期还符合规则5选秀资格，交易他将帮助光芒清理可能严重的40人名单拥堵。
红袜：Kyson Witherspoon，右投手（第4位）Witherspoon的职业首秀没有像预期那样顺利，但他仍是一年前从俄克拉荷马大学被选中的第15顺位，拥有诱人的手臂天赋。他的速球平均95英里/小时，最高98，但缺乏尾劲，他主要用80年代中期滑球和指叉球制造出局。在高阶1A的70局中，他自责分率5.01，73次三振。
洋基：Elmer Rodríguez，右投手（第3位/MLB第73位）Rodríguez已经经历过一次交易，在2024年冬季会议中从红袜来到洋基，换来Carlos Narvaez。他90年代中期伸卡球是制造滚地球的机器，并能用70年代后期曲球和80年代后期指叉球制造挥空。在3A的76.2局中，他自责分率2.93，对手打击率.223，77次三振；同时在大联盟四场先发中自责分率4.76。
美国联盟中区
守护者：Cooper Ingle，捕手/外野手（第3位/MLB第59位）Ingle是2023年从克莱姆森大学被选中的第五轮秀，是一名运动能力出色的捕手，也能守外野角落，并以.987的OPS领跑3A国际联盟。他在64场3A比赛中打击三围.307/.424/.563，职业生涯新高的14支本垒打；在6月底和7月初首次登上大联盟时，21打数2安打12次三振。

皇家：Gavin Cross，外野手（第25位）由于皇家队处于卖模式，他们将努力充实农场而非失去任何东西，但Cross对于任何需要左打外野手的球队来说是一个有趣的上扬选项。2022年第九顺位，Cross在3A奥马哈连续六场比赛击出本垒打，部分原因是他调整了击球准备动作中增加了脚尖触地。自6月以来，Cross在42场比赛中打击三围.316/.368/.589，10支本垒打，139 wRC+。他主要担任右外野手（有时左外野），但在堪萨斯城被Jac Caglianone阻挡，尽管当前球队更可能先给他首次大联盟机会。
老虎：Eduardo Valencia，捕手/一垒手（第11位）Valencia自去年在高阶小联盟的突破赛季首次进入40人名单后，表现并未放缓太多，在大联盟的短样本中表现出色，周二的双响炮尤为亮眼。他也是同一支球队中的捕手，与同为右打重炮手的基石球员Dillon Dingler相比，Dingler只比他大一岁。老虎队是另一支倾向卖家的球队，但想想有多少球队在截止日前寻求捕手补强。

双城：Marek Houston，游击手（第5位）双城队仅落后美联中区两场，且（撰写本文时）落后外卡席位半个胜场，总经理Jeremy Zoll最近表示他们将作为买家。像Walker Jenkins和Kaelen Culpepper这样的百大新秀，两人都即将升上3A，似乎不太可能被交易，但随着Culpepper接近准备就绪，这可能会让另一名游击手如Houston变得可用。球队2025年首轮秀在他的第一个完整赛季表现出色，升到2A，合计打击三围.327/.408/.480，130 wRC+，中线的防守优势突出。

白袜：Billy Carlson，游击手（第3位/MLB第57位）几位球探认为Carlson是他们评估过的最佳防守高中游击手，这就是为什么白袜在2025年以第10顺位选中他。但这支令人惊讶的美联中区领头羊在该位置上也人才济济，包括大联盟先发Colson Montgomery和2026年状元Roch Cholowsky。Carlson在1A的47场比赛中打击三围.267/.396/.361，12次盗垒，最近因左手拇指骨折缺阵七周后回归。
美国联盟西区
天使：George Klassen，右投手（第9位）天使队拥有棒球界最差战绩之一，因此增加大联盟球员似乎不太可能，但Klassen可能带来一些回报价值，与天使可能送走的大联盟天赋相结合。他们在2024年截止日得到了Klassen，他本赛季已有大联盟出场时间，这位24岁的球员仍然拥有顶级球路，速球触及三位数，滑球能制造很多挥空。也许某支竞争球队可以缩短他的上场时间，在冲刺阶段用作牛棚深度。

太空人：Anthony Huezo，外野手（第15位）Huezo在2023年第12轮被太空人从加州高中选中后，花了一些时间才起步，但他在上赛季带领澳大利亚棒球联盟以1.031的OPS领跑，并且是本赛季仅有四位累计至少15支本垒打和30次盗垒的小联盟球员之一。他拥有优秀的原始力量和不错的速度，在两个1A级别的79场比赛中打击三围.248/.347/.513，17支本垒打，32次盗垒，不过他的三振率（30%）仍然令人担忧。
运动家：Zane Taylor，右投手（第18位）运动家在7月初仅落后美联西区三场，但本月表现挣扎，现在落后10场，因此他们买入的可能性很小。他们前30名榜单的顶部正在改善，尤其是即将加入2026年选秀班，很可能保持不变。Taylor是去年选秀班的一员，在第五轮被选中，他正度过一个扎实的第一个完整赛季，最近升到2A，此前在高阶1A兰辛的16场先发中自责分率3.22。

水手：Michael Arroyo，二垒手/外野手（第5位/MLB第40位）虽然有很多关于水手可能从大联盟轮换阵容中交易以改善大联盟阵容的传闻，但他们农场中肯定有资产可以丰富或领导一笔交易。他们不害怕交易百大新秀，就像上赛季送走Harry Ford那样，但你必须认为前两名投手Kade Anderson和Ryan Sloan不会去任何地方。但还有其他四位百大新秀可能被提供。Arroyo打击能力出色（合计OPS .842），年仅21岁，在3A表现出色。在西雅图没有明确的出场时间，也没有明显的长期防守位置，因此换个环境对他也有好处。
游骑兵：Dylan Dreiling，外野手（第10位）作为2024年大学世界系列赛的最杰出球员，他在决赛三场比赛均击出本垒打，带领田纳西州获得全国冠军，Dreiling在一个月后的第二轮被选中。他作为左打者很有吸引力，拥有扎实的击球策略、棒球接触能力和优秀的原始力量，并且是2A德州联盟的最佳打者之一，在83场比赛中打击三围.290/.367/.486，15支本垒打，10次盗垒。
订阅MLB Pipeline通讯
国家联盟东区

勇士：Alex Lodise，游击手（第5位）勇士重返国联东区榜首，正在为季后赛做准备，坦白说，他们系统中的几乎任何人都可以拿来讨论，即使他们最终保留顶级球员。2025年选秀提供了像Tate Southisene和Briggs McKenzie这样的前10顺位新秀，以及Lodise，他们的第二轮选秀。虽然他没有像Southisene那样在今年取得飞跃，但这位内野手的火力已经显现，21支本垒打和15次盗垒，最近升上高阶1A罗马。
马林鱼：Kemp Alderman，外野手/一垒手（第7位）虽然Alderman最突出的地方是他巨大的原始力量和高端的击球初速，但他对于一名6英尺3英寸、225磅的球员来说却出人意料地有运动能力，并拥有优秀的臂力。他在67场3A比赛中打击三围.290/.367/.496，15支本垒打，在因左手肘扭伤缺阵一个月后已完全恢复健康。
大都会：Jonathan Pintaro，右投手（第15位）Pintaro本赛季频繁往返于锡拉丘兹，截至周三，他有五次大联盟出场记录，期间三振12次，将对手打击率限制在.143。作为2024年独立联盟的发现，Pintaro值得称赞，但他也比许多新秀年长，28岁。他可能被纳入更大的交易包裹，为重视他卡特球武器的竞争球队增添牛棚深度。

国民：Coy James，游击手（第18位）华盛顿似乎愿意在今年截止日买和卖，正如Curtis Mead-Connell早期与波士顿的交易所示，他们仍然在国联外卡席位争夺中。如果国民买入，他们不太可能动用顶级新秀，但James（去年在现任管理层接管前第五轮被选中）可能是在下一层级中一个有趣的名字。这位19岁的球员在1A弗雷德里克斯堡的85场比赛中展示了火力，14支本垒打，同时担任过游击手、二垒手、三垒手甚至左外野手。

费城人：Bryan Rincon，游击手（第15位）费城人在每年冲击季后赛时从不回避交易新秀。看看去年截止日，他们送出Eduardo Tait和Mick Abel从双城队换来Jhoan Duran。更有可能的是，当前百大新秀Gage Wood在费城帮助球队，而非被交易，因此我们往下看，Rincon在2A度过了一个突破赛季。这不仅仅是雷丁主场的加成——他的新力量在客场也显现出来——而且他是一名绝对出色的防守游击手。
国家联盟中区

酿酒人：Josh Adamczewski，外野手（第6位/MLB第88位）酿酒人在大联盟球队可能以国联一号种子身份进入季后赛时，农场依然兵强马壮。他们是否会押上新秀筹码将是截止日的看点之一，但如果他们变得激进，Adamczewski的名字可能会在较大交易中频繁出现。这位21岁的左打重炮手延续了去年的突破，在高阶1A和2A的81场比赛中打击三围.313/.431/.546，职业生涯新高的14支本垒打，同时从二垒手转为全职左外野手。凭借以平飞球为主的击球风格，Adamczewski在其他许多组织中会拥有更好的打击工具。

红雀：Leo Bernal，捕手（第5位）圣路易斯确实在捕手位置上人满为患，大联盟有Pedro Pagés、Iván Herrera和Jimmy Crooks，3A有Bernal，2A有顶级新秀Rainiel Rodriguez。这当然是个甜蜜的烦恼，Bernal在孟菲斯的首个赛季79场比赛中打击三围.275/.358/.471，13支本垒打，为此做出了贡献。他传向二垒的爆发时间出色，臂力看起来也准备好登上大联盟。在他首次亮相前交易他可能会获得可观的回报，无论是大联盟天赋还是新秀，以充实农场其他更需要的领域。
小熊：Jefferson Rojas，三垒手/游击手（第2位/MLB第64位）伤病缠身的小熊急需投手，虽然他们可能不会交易头号潜力新秀（外野手Josiah Hartshorn），但可能不得不放弃二号新秀以获取投手帮助。Rojas于2022年以100万美元从多米尼加共和国签下，在2A的86场比赛中（21岁）打击三围.269/.334/.462，15支本垒打，拥有适合内野左侧的臂力。

海盗：Wyatt Sanford，游击手（第4位）海盗愿意放弃谁可能取决于他们想要制造多大的动静。例如，如果Mason Miller可用（似乎不是），那么Edward Florentino或Murf Gray可能被提供。Sanford在格林斯博罗的打击状态逐渐进入百大新秀行列，尤其是力量方面，但手部受伤让他停赛。海盗在中线内野有深度，从匹兹堡的Konnor Griffin开始，因此这将是从强项进行交易。
红人：Tyson Lewis，游击手/三垒手（第4位）去年此时，红人将年轻内野手Sammy Stafura送到海盗队换来Ke'Bryan Hayes，以帮助成功冲击外卡。今年他们更可能是卖家，但如果他们想再次利用内野新秀深度，可以尝试用Lewis来帮助他们更快地切换回竞争模式。他的击球策略有待改进，但拥有原始力量和速度，三垒很可能是他的全职位置。
国家联盟西区

响尾蛇：Carlos Virahonda，捕手（第10位）与红雀一样，响尾蛇在捕手位置上积累了令人羡慕的深度，Virahonda、Alberto Barriga（第14位）和Ivan Luciano（第21位）已在管道中，阿肯色州捕手Ryder Helfrick作为2026年首轮秀加入其中。正是这种深度让亚利桑那可以在此动用，Virahonda可能引起一些兴趣，他是一名潜在的高于平均水平的防守者，本赛季在1A和高阶1A之间已击出16支本垒打，远超去年创下的职业生涯最高4支。

道奇：Zyhir Hope，外野手（第5位/MLB第25位）道奇有多富有？他们拥有最多的百大新秀（九位），而Hope排名第25位，却只是他们的第五号新秀和第四号外野手。他在2024年1月通过Michael Busch交易从小熊队获得，是一名潜在的25-25球员，拥有远高于平均水平的原始力量、不错的速度以及在任何外野位置守备的工具。他在2A度过了一个强劲的赛季，21岁，在91场比赛中打击三围.288/.367/.517，21支本垒打，18次盗垒，以84分打点领跑德州联盟。
巨人：Blade Tidwell，右投手（第11位）Tidwell在去年截止日被交易，作为Tyler Rogers交易包裹的一部分从大都会来到巨人，他最好的两种武器是90年代中期、最高99英里/小时且有尾劲的速球，以及80年代初期扫球。Tidwell本赛季大部分时间在3A担任先发，66.1局自责分率4.21，75次三振，同时在旧金山的八场后援出赛中自责分率3.00。

教士：Kash Mayfield，左投手（第2位）圣迭戈永远不会被排除在让交易截止日变得有趣之外，最近的四连胜（截至周三）应该将他们坚定地推回买家方向。虽然围绕顶级新秀Ethan Salas会有很多询价，但圣迭戈更可能动用其日益庞大的年轻投手储备来做出交易。2024年首轮秀，Mayfield本赛季在高阶1A韦恩堡的53.1局中自责分率3.54，62次三振，虽然他的速球速度并不快（90-93英里/小时），但他82-84英里/小时的变速球看起来像是一个有潜力的优势球路。
洛矶：Zac Veen，外野手（第7位）洛矶正在重建，因此他们的系统很可能保持不变。但Veen可能需要换个环境。虽然我们似乎谈论他很久了，但他仍只有24岁，并且在3A打出了他最好的数据年（.313/.389/.580），17支本垒打，15次盗垒，但自去年在大联盟首秀后，还没有获得另一次在科罗拉多展示能力的机会。

items.titleEn: Sánchez (ankle) nearing return to Blue Jays
items.summaryEn: No. 10 prospect Tiedemann resumes rehab with Single-A Dunedin
bodyEn: Blue Jays outfielder Jesús Sánchez went 2-for-3 with a pair of singles and was hit by a pitch during Triple-A Buffalo’s 5-4 win over Lehigh Valley on Wednesday as he nears activation off the injured list, where he’s been since late June due to a right ankle sprain. He played seven innings in left field before being replaced by a pinch-hitter in the eighth.

Wednesday’s rehab game was Sánchez’s first with Buffalo after he played one game for Toronto’s Florida Complex League club and two with Single-A Dunedin. Over those three contests, the 28-year-old was 1-for-7 (.143) with a pair of walks.
The Jays’ targeted return for Sánchez has been the end of this month, and as we approach August, he seems to be in line for an imminent return after Wednesday’s performance.
Prior to his injury, Sánchez had a .274/.316/.437 slash line with seven home runs in 234 plate appearances for Toronto after the Blue Jays acquired him in an offseason trade with the Astros.

Also on a rehab assignment is the Blue Jays’ No. 10 prospect per MLB Pipeline, left-hander Ricky Tiedemann. Tiedemann experienced left elbow soreness as he continued his recovery from 2024 Tommy John surgery, but he made his first appearance in a professional game in 706 days on June 16, pitching for the FCL club.

Following that start, he was scratched from his next appearance due to a neck issue. He returned to the mound earlier this month, making another start for the FCL team before pitching in a game for Dunedin.

On Wednesday, Tiedemann was back on the mound for Dunedin, throwing a scoreless sixth inning with a strikeout in a 14-9 win over St. Lucie. The Jays hope to build Tiedemann up to the point where he’s pitching regularly out of the bullpen in Triple-A.

bodyZh: 蓝鸟外野手Jesús Sánchez周三在3A Buffalo对阵Lehigh Valley的比赛中5打数2安打，两支一垒安打，并被一次触身球击中，球队5-4获胜。他自6月下旬因右脚踝扭伤进入伤病名单，即将被激活。他在左外野防守了7局，第八局被代打替换。

蓝鸟队的目标是让Sánchez在本月底复出，随着我们接近八月，他在周三的表现之后似乎很快就能回归。
受伤之前，Sánchez在为多伦多出战的234个打席中，打击三围为.274/.316/.437，有7支本垒打。蓝鸟队在休赛期通过交易从太空人队得到了他。
同样在康复训练中的还有蓝鸟队MLB Pipeline排名第10的潜力新秀、左投手Ricky Tiedemann。Tiedemann在2024年接受汤米·约翰手术后恢复过程中出现左肘酸痛，但他于6月16日为FCL球队投球，这是他在职业比赛中的首次出场，距离上次已有706天。

周三，Tiedemann重返Dunedin的投手丘，在球队14-9战胜St. Lucie的比赛中投出一局无失分，并有一次三振。蓝鸟希望将Tiedemann培养到能够在3A稳定从牛棚出赛的水平。

items.titleEn: One day after turning 23, Yesavage flashes ace stuff vs. Nats
bodyEn: WASHINGTON -- Rookie Trey Yesavage continues to pitch like the Blue Jays’ future ace. And on Wednesday afternoon, he was also their present-day stopper.

A day after his 23rd birthday, the right-hander allowed one run and three hits over 6 2/3 innings to help the Blue Jays secure their first series victory in three weeks with a 5-2 win over the Nationals in the rubber game.

After Ernie Clement’s game-tying double in the sixth, Daulton Varsho knocked in the go-ahead run with a seventh-inning infield single off Orlando Ribalto to secure Toronto's first series triumph since taking two of three against the Giants from July 6-8.
Varsho also helped Yesavage with two out-of-the-ordinary grabs in center field to deny Brady House, including a leaping warning-track catch in the first that may have prevented a home run.
Kazuma Okamoto added a two-run double in the eighth for his third hit, then scored on George Springer’s single to provide some welcome insurance.
Yesavage entered Wednesday receiving only 3.4 runs of support per nine innings, the eighth-lowest mark among the 112 pitchers with 15 or more starts across MLB.

But even when it was tight, Yesavage (5-5, 3.73 ERA) rarely encountered trouble, striking out four, walking three and facing only four batters with runners in scoring position. Three of those at-bats came in the fourth, when Jacob Young somehow reached a splitter well off the inside corner to loop a go-ahead two-out double to left before Jorbit Vivas grounded out to second.

The last came in the seventh when Yesavage struck out Vivas on a 2-2 slider that dove out of the zone before Tyler Rogers came on to retire Nasim Nuñez. Rogers got the one out before allowing a run when three straight batters reached in the eighth.

Louis Varland came on and cleaned up Rogers’ jam while preventing two inherited runners from scoring, then completed the ninth for his 23rd save. It was Varland’s second of the series, accomplishing that feat for the first time since consecutive saves against the Red Sox on June 16-17.
items.titleZh: 迈入23岁后首战，Yesavage对国民展现王牌身手
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟新秀Yesavage生日后一天投出6.2局失1分，5-2赢国民夺系列赛。
bodyZh: WASHINGTON -- 新秀 Trey Yesavage 继续像蓝鸟未来的王牌那样投球。而在周三下午，他也是当下球队的止败者。
在他23岁生日后一天，这位右投手投了6 2/3局，失1分，仅被击出3支安打，帮助蓝鸟在决胜战中以5-2击败国民，赢得三周以来的首个系列赛胜利。
在Ernie Clement于第六局击出追平二垒安打后，Daulton Varsho在第七局从Orlando Ribalto手中击出内野安打打回超前分，确保蓝鸟自7月6日至8日对阵巨人赢得三场中的两场以来首次系列赛胜利。
Varsho在中外野两次非同寻常的接杀也帮助了Yesavage，阻挡了Brady House，包括第一局在警告线附近的一次跳跃接杀，可能阻止了一发本垒打。
Kazuma Okamoto在第八局击出两分二垒安打，这是他本场第三支安打，随后在George Springer的安打中得分，提供了一些受欢迎的保险分。
进入周三比赛时，Yesavage每九局仅获得3.4分的支援，这在全MLB中至少15次先发的112名投手中排名倒数第八。
但即使比分胶着，Yesavage（5胜5败，自责分率3.73）也很少陷入麻烦，他三振四人，保送三人，仅面对四名打者时跑者在得点圈。其中三次打席出现在第四局，当时Jacob Young不知何故碰到了一个内角偏外的指叉球，击出超前两分二垒安打至左外野，随后Jorbit Vivas滚地球出局至二垒。
最后一次在第七局，Yesavage用一记2-2的滑球三振Vivas，球掉出好球带，随后Tyler Rogers上场解决Nasim Nuñez。Rogers只投一人次出局，但在第八局连续三名打者上垒，失掉一分。
Louis Varland上场清理Rogers留下的残局，阻止了两名继承跑者得分，随后完成第九局，拿下第23次救援。这是Varland系列赛的第二次救援，自6月16-17日连续救援成功对阵红袜以来首次达成这一成就。

items.titleEn: Bieber's final start before Deadline 'definitely my worst' with Blue Jays
items.summaryEn: Righty records just two outs, sets franchise mark with six walks in tough first inning
bodyEn: WASHINGTON -- Blue Jays right-hander Shane Bieber looked to be finding his rhythm in time to solidify his status as a key asset held by one of the likely sellers at Monday’s Trade Deadline.
Then came Tuesday night’s nightmarish outing in Toronto’s 8-6 loss to Washington at Nationals Park.

Struggling with his grip in a game delayed at the start by 1 hour and 7 minutes due to torrential storms, Bieber walked six batters and retired only two before exiting after only two-thirds of an inning in what could be his final appearance for the club.
The 2020 American League Cy Young Award winner and two-time All-Star threw only 15 of 42 pitches for strikes, while allowing the first four runs to set the Nationals on track to even the series.

“The only thing he really said was it was really hot, he was sweating a lot. Having a tough time gripping the ball,” manager John Schneider said. “The last thing I thought was that, six walks in the first inning from a guy like him.”

By the time Schneider gave Bieber the early hook, he held an infamous new franchise record for most walks issued in an inning. Per Elias Sports Bureau, Bieber was one free pass away from entering truly abnormal territory as the fourth since 1889 to walk seven or more in a single frame. The last time that happened, Senators left-hander Dolly Gray issued eight walks in one inning against the White Sox on Aug. 28, 1909.

“You gotta find a way to get through it, right?” Bieber said. “And I wasn't able to do that tonight, so, ultimately, follow up what was maybe my best start as a Blue Jay with what was definitely my worst. Nobody was more frustrated than me. I let the guys down tonight and so I wear that one wholeheartedly.”
Bieber, who spent most of the first half of the season on the injured list, said the issue wasn’t stuff or anything going on health-wise.
“I got no excuses, man,” he said. “I gotta find a way to get out of that first inning and dry my hands off, and change [my] shirt and eat up innings after that.”
Bieber hurt his own cause when he lost track of the bag covering first base as CJ Abrams hustled out an infield single as one of three batters he faced who did not reach via free pass.
That would’ve led to the second out before Bieber’s last four walks. Instead, his ERA spiked more than a run to 5.74.

Kazuma Okamoto hit his 24th home run in the fifth after entering for the injured Vladimir Guerrero Jr. in the fourth, and George Springer clubbed his 12th, a three-run shot that pulled the Blue Jays within two in the eighth.

But Toronto (49-59) dipped to a season-low-tying 10 games below .500 for a fourth time in the last seven days, sending the probability they’ll be shopping Bieber and others at the 6 p.m. ET Trade Deadline just a little bit higher.
A victory could’ve secured Toronto’s first series win since taking two of three at the Giants on July 6-8, and perhaps prolonged hope of climbing back into playoff contention.

“I would hate to discredit how big of an outing that could have been, [how] big of a game that could have been for us,” Bieber said. “I don't want to say that was just one of those days and I’m past it. I'm definitely frustrated. All I can do is be accountable and move forward, and work toward my next one.”
Bieber was still making a prolonged recovery from 2024 Tommy John surgery when the Blue Jays acquired him in a 2025 Deadline deal.

And after Bieber took a tough Game 7 loss to the Dodgers in the 2025 World Series, allowing Will Smith’s 11th-inning solo homer, Bieber surprised most onlookers by picking up his ‘26 player option for $16 million only days after the painful defeat.

By late March, Bieber was placed on the 15-day IL with right elbow inflammation, and when he was finally cleared to pitch again, he made five rehab starts to come close to simulating a Spring Training buildup.

That did not lead to immediate success upon his Major League return, but Bieber showed signs of his earlier Guardians days in his previous two outings, allowing only six hits and two walks across those successive quality starts.
items.titleZh: 比伯在交易截止日前的最后一场先发‘绝对是我最差的一次’
items.summaryZh: 右投手仅制造两个出局数，首局创下队史六次保送纪录
bodyZh: 华盛顿讯——蓝鸟右投手Shane Bieber本有望找回节奏，巩固其作为交易截止日（周一）潜在卖家所持关键资产的地位。
然而周二晚在国民公园球场，多伦多8-6负于华盛顿的比赛却成了噩梦。
由于暴雨导致比赛推迟1小时7分钟开始，Bieber在控球上挣扎，他保送了六名打者，仅制造两个出局数，在投了仅仅2/3局后退场，这可能是他代表球队的最后一场比赛。
这位2020年美国联盟赛扬奖得主、两届全明星球员，42球中仅有15球是好球，同时让前四分得分，使国民队追平系列赛。
“他唯一说的就是天气太热，他流了很多汗。控球很困难。”主教练John Schneider说，“我完全没想到，像他这样的投手会在第一局保送六次。”
当Schneider早早将Bieber换下时，他创造了一项不光彩的队史纪录——单局最多保送次数。据Elias体育局统计，Bieber距离进入真正异常领域仅一步之遥：自1889年以来，单局保送七次或以上的投手只有四位。上一次发生这种情况是1909年8月28日，参议员队左投Dolly Gray在对阵白袜的一局中保送了八名打者。
“你得想办法挺过去，对吧？”Bieber说，“但今晚我没能做到，所以，最终，继可能是我作为蓝鸟球员最好的先发之后，迎来了绝对是最差的一次。没有人比我更沮丧。我今晚让队友们失望了，所以我完全承担这个责任。”
Bieber本赛季上半场大部分时间都在伤病名单上，他表示问题不在于状态或健康方面。
“我没有借口，兄弟，”他说，“我得想办法摆脱第一局，把手擦干，换件衬衫，然后继续吃局数。”
当CJ Abrams奋力跑出一个内野安打时，Bieber忘记踩一垒垒包，这加重了他的困境。Abrams是他面对的三名未通过保送上垒的打者之一。
这本该在Bieber最后四次保送之前制造第二个出局数。相反，他的自责分率飙升超过一分至5.74。
冈本和真在第五局击出第24支本垒打——他在第四局替换受伤的Vladimir Guerrero Jr.上场——George Springer则敲出第12支，一记三分炮在第八局将分差缩小到两分。
但多伦多（49胜59负）在过去七天内第四次跌至低于五成胜率10场，追平赛季最低，这使他们将在美国东部时间下午6点的交易截止日兜售Bieber和其他球员的可能性略增。
一场胜利本可为多伦多确保自7月6日至8日对阵巨人拿下两胜以来的首个系列赛胜利，或许还能延续重返季后赛竞争的希望。
“我不想贬低这次出局的重要性，这对我们来说可能是一场重大的比赛，”Bieber说，“我不想说这只是普通的一天，我已经翻篇了。我绝对很沮丧。我能做的就是承担责任，向前看，为下一次做好准备。”
Bieber仍在从2024年的Tommy John手术中恢复，蓝鸟在2025年交易截止日的一笔交易中得到了他。
在2025年世界大赛中，Bieber在第七场苦战负于道奇，被Will Smith在第十一局击出再见阳春炮。仅几天后，Bieber出人意料地执行了2026年价值1600万美元的球员选项。
3月底，Bieber因右肘发炎被放入15日伤病名单。当他最终获准再次投球时，他进行了五次复健先发，以模拟春训的调整。
这并未立即在大联盟回归中取得成功，但Bieber在前两次出赛中展现了早期守护者时期的风采，连续优质先发中仅被击出六支安打、保送两人。

items.titleEn: Varland brothers reunite for exchange of lineup cards
bodyEn: WASHINGTON – The Nationals and Blue Jays game was a family affair for the Varland brothers.
Gus and Louis Varland participated in a memorable lineup card exchange prior to Tuesday’s game at Nationals Park.
Louis pitched a scoreless inning for Toronto in the series opener on Monday. The following afternoon, Gus was called up from Triple-A Rochester to rejoin Washington’s bullpen.
The siblings from Minnesota reunited at home plate for the pregame ceremony.
Louis, 28, earned his first All-Star selection this season with a 1.02 ERA and 22 saves. Gus, 29, made the Nationals' Opening Day roster and has earned six saves.
This is another notable day at the park for the duo. Back in 2022, the brothers faced off as starters in the Minor Leagues in a Double-A game between the Tulsa Drillers and Wichita Wind Surge.

items.titleEn: Blue Jays top pick Carlon has lofty goals and serious stuff
bodyEn: TORONTO -- These days, Blue Jays fans are left looking to the future, whether they want to or not.

There’s a lot to like, though, in a farm system that’s grown stronger at the top and done a much better job of developing pitchers in recent years. Cole Carlon, the Blue Jays’ top pick in the 2026 MLB Draft (No. 39 overall), represents that next wave of talent.
Fresh off their success developing Trey Yesavage, Carlon will join a system that also boasts Nolan Perry (No. 3), Johnny King (No. 4), Gage Stanifer (No. 7) and Ricky Tiedemann (No. 10).
After Carlon met with the media for the first time Tuesday since signing his deal with the Blue Jays, this is what you need to know:
Carlon’s path to Toronto:

Carlon and Blue Jays area scout Adam Arnold, who’s based in Arizona, built a good relationship throughout the scouting process. Carlon also had a great resource at Arizona State in his pitching coach, Jeremy Accardo, who pitched five seasons for the Blue Jays from 2006-10.

“I’m relentless,” Carlon said. “I’m going to go out there, compete, get to two strikes as soon as I can and try to get as many outs as possible, any way I can. I really just love going out there to compete and going right after guys with my stuff.”

Carlon singled out Tigers ace Tarik Skubal as a pitcher he models his game after, both big lefties. Skubal threw bullpens at ASU during the offseason, too, so Carlon was able to watch one of the best pitchers on the planet work and pick his brain about what goes into a successful big league career.

After shifting from ASU’s bullpen to the rotation in his junior year, Carlon’s Draft stock skyrocketed and he was projected by many public rankings to be picked higher than No. 39. Scott Boras, who represents Carlon, continued to praise the Blue Jays’ organization, calling this pick “a feather in Toronto's cap."

“Normally in the Draft, when you have Cole’s abilities, they’re going at much higher levels,” Boras said. “The benefit here is that his late development was not as widely known as you’d expect. What you saw his junior year was, frankly, something where I think that few in this Draft had those abilities.”
The upside:
A fastball that lives in the upper 90s with one of the best sliders in the Draft -- a true wipeout pitch -- is a fine place to start.

“One of my friends texted me after, and I was laughing about the way he put it. He said that ‘He’s got two October pitches,’” said director of amateur scouting Marc Tramuta. “I felt like that was a good characterization of the fastball and slider that are currently in place. We just like the big physicality at 6-foot-5. We think there’s some athleticism to his delivery.”

Like Boras said, Carlon’s development came late in the process. He is, by Draft standards and especially at his age (21), a “fresh arm.” He also stands 6-foot-5, 230 pounds. There’s nothing but upside here.

Building out the rest of Carlon’s arsenal will be the key to succeeding in the big leagues, but with his fastball and slider alone, Carlon should carve through the lower levels of the Minor Leagues when he gets his start in pro ball.
Next steps for Carlon:

It’s easy to dream of another quick mover after Yesavage shot from Single-A to the World Series in 2025, touching every level of the Blue Jays’ system in the process. That’s going to grab the attention of the next guy that comes along, too.

“My goal is to be a big leaguer as soon as possible,” Carlon said. “I’m happy they have the ability to put a guy like me, who just got drafted, in the position to become a big leaguer next year. That was definitely awesome to see. That’s my goal, to be pitching in the big leagues as soon as I can. I’ve still got to run my own race, and I’ll get there when I get there.”

Coming off 83 2/3 innings last season at ASU, which was already a spike in workload as he moved from the bullpen, don’t expect to see Carlon pitching much this season, if at all. He could very well start the 2027 season on Yesavage’s path, though, making only brief stops in Single-A Dunedin and High-A Vancouver as the Blue Jays get him on their program. It’s a program that, all of the sudden, is producing some great results with pitchers just like Carlon.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟首轮秀Carlon目标远大且武器犀利
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟2026年首轮秀Cole Carlon立志尽快升上大联盟，其高速球和滑球被视为顶级武器。
bodyZh: 多伦多 -- 如今，蓝鸟球迷不论愿不愿意，只能展望未来。
不过，有太多值得期待的地方：农场系统顶端变得更加雄厚，近年来在培养投手方面也做得更好。2026年MLB选秀蓝鸟首轮第39顺位选中的Cole Carlon，正是下一波天赋的代表。
在成功培养Trey Yesavage之后，Carlon将加入一个还拥有Nolan Perry（第3）、Johnny King（第4）、Gage Stanifer（第7）和Ricky Tiedemann（第10）的系统。
周二，Carlon与蓝鸟签约后首次接受媒体采访，以下是您需要了解的信息：
Carlon通往多伦多的道路：
Carlon与蓝鸟球队球探Adam Arnold（驻亚利桑那）在球探过程中建立了良好关系。Carlon在亚利桑那州立大学（ASU）的投手教练Jeremy Accardo也为他提供了巨大帮助，Accardo在2006-10赛季为蓝鸟投了五个赛季。
“我永不言弃，”Carlon说，“我会走上投手丘，竞争，尽快拿到两好球，然后想尽办法尽可能多地制造出局。我真的很喜欢上场竞争，用我的武器直接攻击打者。”
Carlon特别提到老虎王牌Tarik Skubal是他模仿的对象，两人都是高大的左投手。Skubal休赛期也在ASU投过牛棚，因此Carlon得以观察这位地球上最好的投手之一是如何训练的，并向他请教成功的大联盟生涯需要什么。
在三年级从ASU的牛棚转入轮值后，Carlon的选秀行情飙升，许多公开排名预计他会在第39顺位之前被选中。代表Carlon的Scott Boras继续称赞蓝鸟组织，称这一选秀是“蓝鸟帽子上的一根羽毛”。
“通常在选秀中，像Cole这样的能力会去更高的顺位，”Boras说，“好处是，他的晚熟没有像预期那样广为人知。他三年级展现的能力，坦率地说，我认为本届选秀中很少有人具备。”
优势：
一颗常驻90英里以上的快速球，以及本届选秀中最好的滑球之一——真正的终结球——是一个很好的起点。
“我的一位朋友后来发信息给我，他说的方式让我发笑。他说‘他有两个十月球’，我觉得这是对现有快速球和滑球的恰当描述，”业余球探总监Marc Tramuta说，“我们喜欢他6英尺5英寸的身材。我们认为他的投球动作有些运动能力。”
如Boras所说，Carlon的成长过程较晚。按选秀标准，尤其是他21岁的年龄，他属于“新鲜手臂”。他身高6英尺5英寸，体重230磅。只有上升空间。
构建Carlon其余球路将是在大联盟取得成功的关键，但仅凭他的快速球和滑球，Carlon在职业棒球起步时应该就能轻松横扫小联盟低级别联赛。
Carlon的下一步：
在Yesavage从1A直接升到2025年世界大赛、一路经历蓝鸟系统每个级别之后，很容易梦想另一个快速晋升者。这也会吸引下一位来者的注意。
“我的目标是尽快成为大联盟球员，”Carlon说，“我很高兴他们能让像我这样刚被选中的球员有机会在明年成为大联盟球员。这绝对令人惊叹。这就是我的目标，尽快在大联盟投球。但我仍然要跑自己的比赛，我会在合适的时候到达那里。”
上赛季在ASU投了83又2/3局，这已经是从牛棚转过来的工作量激增，预计本赛季Carlon不会投太多，如果投的话。不过，他很可能在2027赛季沿着Yesavage的道路起步，只在1A Dunedin和高级1A Vancouver短暂停留，蓝鸟将把他纳入自己的培养计划。这个计划突然之间在培养像Carlon这样的投手方面产生了出色的成果。

items.titleEn: Scherzer grinds through birthday return to Nationals Park
bodyEn: WASHINGTON -- Max Scherzer’s second return from an IL stint this season went better than his first, enough so that he’s hopeful for what could still be ahead.

Scherzer labored through 2 2/3 innings on 75 pitches on his 42nd birthday, but he escaped by allowing only one run in his former home park in the Blue Jays’ 3-2 win over the Nationals in Monday night’s series opener.

“I knew it was going to be a little rusty,” Scherzer said after his 100th career start at Nationals Park. “I knew this happens when you come off the IL, and you haven't pitched as much. Every time out, it should be a little bit better, a little bit better, a little bit better execution.
“If I can get that going, I know I can still compete at this level at the highest level and compete against anybody. So it should be fun for me in the second half here.”

In the three-time Cy Young Award winner’s first outing since June 10, he struck out four to move within eight of Walter Johnson (3,515) for 10th all-time on MLB’s all-time strikeout list (according to the Elias Sports Bureau, the official statistician of Major League Baseball). Scherzer also walked three and allowed four hits.

In the process, he lowered his ERA by about three-quarters of a run, to 9.49, in his seventh start this season and first since he landed back on the IL with a combination of back spasms and right thumb inflammation. He has retired more than 10 batters in only two of those outings, both of those coming before his first injury setback due to right forearm tightness and left ankle inflammation.
Most encouraging for Blue Jays manager John Schneider was an absence of strong contact, aside from Luis García Jr.’s second-inning RBI double.

“I thought he battled really well, you know what I mean?” Schneider said. “They were fouling off some stuff, and the walks were kind of uncharacteristic of him. But really only one hard-hit ball from García, and he gave us everything he had.”
In Scherzer’s previous return from the IL on June 10, he allowed five runs in 3 1/3 innings before landing back on the IL.

Barring any other setbacks, Scherzer might have one more outing before the Aug. 3 Trade Deadline to convince possible trade suitors he’s worth a low-risk flyer (should he waive the no-trade clause in his one-year, $3 million deal).

“I can't 100% say, the way this has gone for me, but I am in a good spot,” he said of another potential start on Sunday. “I do think I'll recover out well from this one and hopefully continue to march back up and get built back up as a starter here.”
Asked what could still be accomplished this season for the last-place Blue Jays (49-58), Scherzer alluded to ignoring the chatter that Toronto could be Deadline sellers.

“Look, our record is our record,” he said. “It’s frustrating as heck that we’re in this position, but we’re professionals. We have a job to do. … You’ve got to go out there and do everything you can to win, every single day. That’s the mentality we have in the clubhouse, and we kind of let the other stuff just be noise.”

Luis Urías homered, Ernie Clement hit an RBI double and Myles Straw singled in a run for Toronto. Mason Fluharty and Spencer Miles each worked 1 1/3 scoreless innings of relief, Tyler Rogers and Jeff Hoffman pitched one scoreless frame each and Louis Varland stranded a pair of runners in the ninth for his 22nd save.
Scherzer received a standing ovation of roughly 30 seconds when he first took the mound at Nationals Park, the venue he called home from 2015-21.

He worked out of a bases-loaded jam in the first, striking out Dylan Crews before inducing Daylen Lile into a groundout. After Scherzer allowed García’s RBI double, he stranded two more Nationals by fielding José Tena’s chopper himself.
He departed with one aboard in the third to another appreciative applause from the crowd as he walked off after a 12-pitch strikeout of Lile and a brief mound visit with Schneider.

“I got out there, and I just wanted to check on him, and he said, ‘Your call,’” Schneider said. “And I said, ‘That was a lot. That was a lot right there.’ And he's like, ‘Yeah.’ He's like, ‘Your call.’ And I said, ‘OK, nice job.’”
items.titleZh: 谢泽尔生日重返国民球场 2.2局失1分
items.summaryZh: 谢泽尔42岁生日重返国民球场，先发2.2局仅失1分，蓝鸟3-2取胜。
bodyZh: 华盛顿——马克斯·谢泽尔本赛季第二次从伤病名单回归的表现比第一次更好，足以让他对未来仍抱有希望。
谢泽尔在42岁生日当天用75球苦撑2.2局，但在蓝鸟周一晚间系列赛首战3-2战胜国民的比赛中，他在老东家主场只失1分，成功摆脱困境。
“我知道会有些生疏，”谢泽尔在职业生涯第100次于国民球场先发后说道。“我知道当你从伤病名单回归、投球不多时就会这样。每次出赛，执行都会好一点、好一点、再好一点。”
“如果我能保持下去，我知道自己仍然可以在最高水平上竞争，与任何人对抗。所以下半赛季对我来说应该会很有趣。”
这位三届赛扬奖得主自6月10日以来的首次出赛中，他投出4次三振，距离沃尔特·约翰逊（3,515次）仅差8次，升至MLB历史三振榜第10位（根据MLB官方统计机构埃利亚斯体育局统计）。谢泽尔还投出3次保送，被击出4支安打。
在此过程中，他将自己的自责分率降低了约0.75，降至9.49，这是他本赛季第七次先发，也是他因背部痉挛和右手拇指发炎再次进入伤病名单后的首次先发。在这七次出赛中，他只有两次解决了超过10名打者，而且这两次都发生在他因右前臂紧绷和左脚踝发炎首次受伤之前。
对蓝鸟总教练John Schneider来说，最令人鼓舞的是除了Luis García Jr.在第二局打出的打点二垒安打外，没有强劲的击球。
“我认为他战斗得很努力，你明白我的意思吗？”Schneider说。“他们打出了一些界外球，保送有点不像他。但实际上只有García打出一颗硬击球，他付出了自己的一切。”
在谢泽尔6月10日此前一次从伤病名单回归时，他在3.1局中失5分，随后再次进入伤病名单。
除非出现其他挫折，谢泽尔可能在8月3日交易截止日前还有一次出赛，以向可能的交易追求者证明他值得低风险押注（如果他放弃一年300万美元合同中的不可交易条款）。
“我不能100%确定，考虑到我目前的情况，但我处于一个良好的位置，”他在谈到周日可能再次先发时说道。“我确实认为我会从这次出赛中恢复得很好，并希望继续回升，在这里重新建立起先发投手的状态。”
当被问及对于垫底的蓝鸟（49胜58负）本赛季还能取得什么成就时，谢泽尔暗示忽略关于蓝鸟可能在交易截止日前成为卖家的传闻。
“听着，我们的战绩就是我们的战绩，”他说。“我们处于这个位置令人沮丧，但我们是职业球员。我们有工作要做……你必须每天上场尽一切努力去赢。这就是我们更衣室的心态，我们让其他事情成为噪音。”
Luis Urías击出本垒打，Ernie Clement敲出打点二垒安打，Myles Straw击出一分打点一垒安打，为多伦多贡献得分。Mason Fluharty和Spencer Miles各后援1.1局无失分，Tyler Rogers和Jeff Hoffman各投一局无失分，Louis Varland在第九局留下两名跑者，拿下第22次救援成功。
当谢泽尔第一次登上国民球场投手丘时，他获得了大约30秒的起立鼓掌，这座球场是他2015年至2021年期间的主场。
他在第一局化解了满垒危机，先三振Dylan Crews，再让Daylen Lile击出滚地球出局。在谢泽尔被García击出打点二垒安打后，他亲自处理了José Tena的滚地球，再留下两名国民打者。
第三局他在一出局一垒有人时退场，在用一个12球三振Lile并与Schneider进行简短投手丘会面后，他走下投手丘，再次获得观众感激的掌声。
“我走到那里，只是想看看他，他说‘你决定’，”Schneider说。“我说‘那是很多球了。那里已经很多了。’他回答说‘嗯。’他说‘你决定。’我说‘好的，干得好。’”
